picks.editorial_note: MIT's Barzilay and Collins won the 2026 Pritzker Prize for pioneering AI-enabled antibiotic discovery, a top-tier scientific honor validating AI's growing role in drug discovery against the global threat of antibiotic resistance.
picks.title: Regina Barzilay and Jim Collins win Pritzker Prize for AI and Science Research Excellence for work in AI-enabled antibiotic discovery

picks.editorial_note: Cambridge researchers used an AI-guided design technique to create a broad-spectrum bird flu vaccine achieving complete protection in animal trials, a concrete step toward pandemic-ready vaccine platforms.
picks.title: Scientists are using AI to develop superior vaccines against viruses threatening global health

picks.editorial_note: Anthropic's pledge of up to $100 billion in equity to the public, alongside SpaceX's similar move, raises major questions about how AI windfalls will be distributed and signals the scale of wealth now concentrated in frontier AI firms.
picks.title: Billions in SpaceX, Anthropic Stock Pledged to the Public. Who Benefits? - Georgetown University

picks.editorial_note: Germany is backing TUM's new autonomous public transportation testbed with up to 20 million euros in federal funding, a significant government bet on AI-driven mobility infrastructure.
picks.title: Autonomous Public Transportation: TUM Opens New DZM Location in Munich

picks.editorial_note: HKUST's MoU with robotics firm Unitree, building toward a joint lab, marks a notable academia-industry push to accelerate embodied AI and robotics commercialization.
picks.title: HKUST and Unitree Sign MoU to Advance Embodied AI and Robotics Collaboration
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: Google.org funding to modernize ANU's widely-used fusion simulation code with AI illustrates how tech-industry philanthropy is directly accelerating fusion energy research.
picks.title: ANU receives Google funding to boost fusion energy research with AI

picks.editorial_note: An NIH-funded, Case Western-led multi-institutional effort will apply AI to satellite and health data to untangle environmental drivers of Alzheimer's and dementia, a large-scale application of AI to a major public health problem.
picks.title: Case Western Reserve-led team to study how the environment contributes to Alzheimer’s and dementia | CWRU Newsroom | Case Western Reserve University

picks.editorial_note: Tel Aviv University and Stanford researchers showed AI models can learn general predictive skills purely from self-generated synthetic data, a finding with implications for reducing AI's dependence on scarce real-world training data.
picks.title: AI Learns to Predict the World Without Ever Seeing It

picks.editorial_note: The DOE's release of 'Genesis Agent Skills,' developed with Fermilab, standardizes agentic AI tooling for scientific machine learning across national labs, a policy-driven infrastructure move with broad research impact.
picks.title: ‘Genesis Agent Skills’ release to support innovation across the Genesis Mission

picks.editorial_note: Imperial College London's engagement at NVIDIA's GTC Berlin highlights deepening academia-industry ties around compute infrastructure that underpin next-generation AI research.
picks.title: Imperial experts explore the next generation of AI at NVIDIA GTC Berlin
